name: Yeraltı
summary: Haydar Ali after avenging his family's murder, ends up in prison. There, he finds himself in the middle of one of Türkiye's most dangerous underground cartels. However, the truly deadly confrontation begins three years later, when he regains his freedom and learns that the woman whom he has never been able to forget, is now the wife of the man closest to him.

name: Christmas Top 5
summary: Mammoth's Mike Bubbins and celebrity friends are making a list (and checking it twice) of Christmas crackers. What are their all time festive favourites from TV, film and music?

name: Три друга, клад и матрос Кошка
The Cross Connection with Tiffany Cross
Wogan's Perfect Recall
summary: Wogan's Perfect Recall is a British quiz show hosted by Terry Wogan in which contestants test both their general knowledge and their memory. As the game progresses, answers given earlier return to challenge players later, rewarding those who can recall information under pressure. The last contestant standing faces a high-stakes final for the chance to win a substantial cash prize.

name: Crimen por encargo
summary: The tragic story of Yalenis, a young Cuban woman trapped in a toxic relationship with a Galician businessman. Her desire for independence triggers a series of events that lead to her and an unknown young man's double murder. Through a police investigation and revealing testimonies, the series unveils the depths to which obsession and power can drive people.

name: Missing in Murcia
summary: A two-part miniseries about the murder of Ingrid Visser and her partner in Murcia. The pregnant volleyball player traveled with Severein for personal and financial reasons. Both were brutally murdered and buried in a lemon grove. The investigation revealed debts and shady dealings linked to a volleyball club.

name: Dünyada Neler Oluyor?
summary: Eymen Studios imzalı, 2026 yılında EXXEN'de yayınlanacak olan "Dünyada Neler Oluyor?" adlı belgesel programı...

name: The Big Idea with Donny Deutsch
The First Man
summary: A drama depicting a life-threatening confrontation between a woman who takes another person's life for revenge and a woman who takes another person's life for her own desires.

name: HNM De Podcast
summary: In HNM, the podcast, Hélène Hendriks, Noa Vahle, and Merel Ek bring together the best of television, sports, and politics in an open conversation.

name: Virgin Media News Update
summary: All the latest breaking news with the Virgin Media News team.

name: Siar 20 Bliain
summary: Analysis of the newly released classified state files.

name: Take the Plunge
summary: Adapted from the American format Blackout, Take the Plunge featured two teams competing in a series of word-based challenges that combined description, deduction and strategic decision-making under time pressure. Hosted by Su Pollard and produced by Thames Television for ITV, the programme emphasised clarity of communication and tactical play, with success in the main game determining a team's opportunity to compete for the final prize.

name: Så byggdes Sverige
summary: Why does Sweden look the way it does? Petra Mede, Gert Wingårdh and Mark Isitt take us on an entertaining journey through time about how our Swedish houses, homes and cities have developed, starting 100 years ago and looking 100 years into the future. Follow us to the private street, the big city, the industrial town, the country, the dream village, the suburbs, the city centre and the village!

previousepisode.name: Byn – en för alla, alla för en

name: Music Japan
summary: Music Show where live acts performed and were interviewed

name: Terra Forte
summary: Presumed dead for nearly twenty years, Flor reappears in Azores with a revelation capable of shaking the past and reshaping the present: her disappearance was not an accident, as everyone believed. The reunion with those who thought they had lost her forever, including a former love, reopens deep wounds and sets in motion a dangerous quest for justice.

name: SupermodelMe
summary: SupermodelMe is a multi-platform reality series in which a number aspiring models of Asian heritage compete for a chance to launch their career in the fashion industry.

name: Blackout
summary:
Blackout saw two teams, each consisting of a contestant paired with a celebrity, compete to solve word puzzles. Each puzzle was a sentence or short paragraph with four missing words. One team member described a missing word while the contestant listened to the description afterward, but the opposing team could use a "blackout" button to mute parts of the clue to make guessing harder. Correctly guessed words earned money and a chance to solve the main puzzle.

Winners advanced to a bonus round ("Clue Screen") where they had a limited time to guess up to five subjects from accumulating clues for a top prize.

name: Shanhai Jing Mima
summary: Shang prince Youshen Bupo rescued Jiang Li, disciple of Taiyi Sect, and the two of them traveled together, adventuring across the vast wilderness. They joined a merchant caravan, encountered heavenly tribulations, faced fierce beasts, defeated bandits, and rescued the heroine… Bound together by fate, the two became embroiled in a great war between the Xia and Shang dynasties

name: Hard Nights
summary: Aon, 54, a cartoonist once famous for his work "Kittima, the Magical Girl of the Enchanted City," is facing a vulnerable period in his life. His career is failing, his health is declining, and his relationship with his 55-year-old marketing professional, Jira, is showing signs of nearing a dead end. The days of laughter have gradually faded, and accumulated stress is causing Aon insomnia. A fortune teller even predicted that this year would be a year of "breakup" in his life.

name: Paint You on My Bed Sheet
summary: Back in high school, gloomy Tong fell for ray-of-sunshine Fah, with his radiant smile and the way he made Tong feel safe and worthy of love. Today, the life they share in their rented apartment is intimate, soft yet sharp, uncomplicated, with Fah always there waiting for him when he gets home. However, something lingers between them that remains unspoken. There's an evident fear abiding in Tong, and one day, Fah says, "Are you really so scared of me, Tong? That's odd. You didn't seem nearly so afraid when you dumped my corpse in the water."

name: El Tiempo de las Moscas
summary: Fresh out of prison and low on options, two women run a fumigation business — until a shady client pulls them back into the life they fought to escape.

name: Meu Namorado Coreano
summary: Five Brazilian women, each at a different stage of life and love, travel to South Korea and meet their crushes in this K-drama-inspired reality show.

name: Serious Business with Anthony Edwards
summary: Anthony Edwards, the superstar guard for the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves, is all business. On the court or off, he's ready to challenge whoever, whenever. Perhaps he's crazy or maybe he's a genius, but Edwards believes he can challenge the world's most elite athletes and biggest celebrities in any competition imaginable - and believes he can win. For him, competition is Serious Business.

previousepisode.name: Table Tennis vs. Marshawn Lynch and Lily Zhang

name: Killarney Historic Rally
summary: Highlights from the event, which featured eight stages including two runs of Moll's Gap.

name: Phantom Lawyer
summary: While Shin Yi Rang dreams of joining a prestigious law firm, he's constantly rejected due to his father's criminal past. Undeterred, he "borrows" money from his mother and opens up his own law firm in a building formerly owned by a shaman. His life and career take a supernatural turn after incense he found in a desk drawer gifts him with the ability to communicate with – and be possessed by – ghosts. With unexpected help from elite lawyer Han Na Hyun, Yi Rang is able to get justice for his first ghostly client, although she's reluctant to admit that spirits are truly speaking to Yi Rang. As their peculiar partnership continues to develop, Yi Rang and Na Hyun find themselves growing closer in more ways than one, all while helping lingering spirits get the closure they need to pass on.

name: Четыре четверти
summary: Straight-A student Masha dreams of winning a gold medal, but her love for the romantic Zhenya stands in her way.

name: A Que No Me Dejas
summary: Paulina and Adrián declaring their love and willing to go against their families in order to be happy. Paulina is the daughter of Gonzalo Murat, a rich hotel businessman who does not accept her courtship because he considers that Adrián is not at the social level that they have. However, Paulina is really in love and this doesn't matter to her.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: El amor lo vence todo

name: La Verdad Oculta
summary: The story revolves around two intertwined couples navigating love, betrayal, and hidden secrets in a tale of intrigue and redemption.[4]David Genovés, a young man from a wealthy family, falls deeply in love with Gabriela Guillén, but their relationship is threatened by a dark secret shared between Gabriela's father, Fausto, and David's father, Mario Genovés, involving illicit business and a hidden tunnel.[4]Meanwhile, Juan José Victoria, who has spent 11 years in prison for a crime he did not commit, seeks justice and rekindles a romance with Alejandra Balmori, a successful architect from an affluent background, amid rivalries and family conflicts.

name: Alborada
summary: Set in the late colonial era of 18th-century Panama and Mexico, Alborada is a historical telenovela centered on a young woman's struggle for justice and true love amidst social rigidities.

name: Abrazame Muy Fuerte
summary: Cristina is a beautiful young woman with a powerful father. She falls in love with a simple worker at her hacienda and gets pregnant. Her father does everything he can to separate the lovers and gives the child to Raquel, a maid at the hacienda. Years pass and a blind Cristina is married to a powerful Federico, her daughter Maria del Carmen a beautiful woman. A young doctor by the name of Jose Manuel arrives to town and catches Maria del Carmens attention. But Federico, Jose Manuels uncle, is also infatuated with the young girl and does everything in his power to separate them.

name: Pharma
summary: A young medical representative struggles against the pharma game, masters it and eventually fights against it.

name: Amarte Es Mi Pecado
summary: Amarte es mi pecado follows the dramatic transformation of an innocent young woman into a hardened, vengeful socialite after a series of tragic betrayals

name: Amar sin límites
summary: Follow Halil Ibrahim as he seeks revenge for the death of the love of his life. His plans are derailed when he meets Zeynep from the Leto family.

name: 9 feestjes voor de kater
summary: Not a rom-com, but a friend-com. Will Aster and Celie's friendship survive the nine parties and their accompanying hangovers?

previousepisode.name: De beste kater van ons leven

name: Amigas y rivales
summary: Four girlfriends from different social classes experience what's it like being 20 - working and studying, falling in love, getting drugs or fighting a terminal illness.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: El tesoro de la amistad

name: Amor Amargo
summary:
The romance between Tomás and Gabriela blossoms at an artisan fair, unaware of their families' connection: years earlier, their parents experienced an impossible love. During the fair, Gabriela learns that her mother has had an accident and must return home, while Tomás receives the news of his father's death. At the funeral, they discover that their parents were involved in the same accident—one that appears to have been intentional. 

Driven by grief and a desire for justice, Tomás moves to Todos Los Santos to uncover the truth and seek revenge on Leonor, Gabriela's grandmother, whom he suspects is responsible. Now, family secrets and the past will test their love, forcing them to confront forces that could tear them apart forever.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2 - Decido acabar esta guerra

name: Amor Dividido
summary:
Abril and Max have nothing in common. She loves living in her small town and working on the fields. He has overlooked his roots and lives happily in a first world country.It would be difficult for these two people to fall in love, but for various reasons their lives begin to change radically until they come together amidst the loneliness and disappointment in which their respective partners have left them. 

Debra, Max's wife, divorces because she can't get used to the country where her parents moved years ago. On the other hand, Bruno, Abril's husband, abandons her because he dreams of living in the United States and making dollars to get ahead.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Escribir una historia de amor

name: Amores de Mercado
summary: Amores de Mercado tells the story of Fernando, an ambitious man who driven by greed will do the unimaginable to his own family, Lucía, a woman in search of her husband, and Diego, an athlete who feels defeated by life. Lucia and Diego will meet and find a reason to love again and start over in life, however, destiny will put them to the test. This is a story of second chances and how love can save us when everything else is lost.

name: Smosh
summary: Join us on Fridays for Bit City, Spud Hut, and more! Become a member for extra content we had to cut!

name: Apuesta Por Un Amor
summary: Julia Montaño is the daughter of Don Julio Montaño, a wealthy landowner in the Yucatán Peninsula. She is a beautiful, strong-willed and sometimes arrogant woman, who flouts her father's will and the customs of their small town by spending her days herding cattle and overseeing the management of her father's ranch. She has two siblings - Álvaro, a dissipated young man who spends the majority of his time chasing girls and getting drunk, and Soledad, a beautiful and ingenuous young girl who falls in love with Gabriel Durán, the handsome gamester and ex-lover of their greedy step-mother Cassandra, who moves to San Gaspar after winning the hacienda of Don Ignacio Andrade, Julio's closest friend, in a poker game. Don Ignacio's son, Francisco, has been in love with Julia, but after discovering that he has become involved with the town harlot, Eva, spurns him for Gabriel. Julia doesn't let herself be domesticated by anyone, but despite all the disagreements, she has to admit she is deeply in love with Gabriel. Nevertheless, after she catches him cheating her with Eva, Julia declines his marriage proposal. Although she claims to utterly hate him, she eventually accepts to marry him, only to save her family's fortune that Don Julio foolishly lost in a bet with Gabriel. At first their marriage is full of fights and hateful words as Julia is determined to make Gabriel pay for his faults, but her heart softens after giving birth to their son. Things seem to look up for them and they start living as a normal couple, but the real troubles are yet to come.

name: Bajo las Riendas del Amor
summary: Montserrat is a girl who lives with her wealthy parents who adore her and Juan José, her boyfriend, loves her very much. Ingrid envies everything that makes her cousin Montserrat happy and decides to destroy her love with Juan José.

name: Barrera de Amor
summary: Barrera de Amor revolves around María Teresa "Maité" Galván, a humble and hardworking young woman, who lives in the town of Santa María, Aguascalientes, and works at her aunt's fonda. She becomes engaged to Luis Antonio Romero, a widowed veterinarian and single father, but their romance is shattered when Maité is assaulted by the wealthy and arrogant Adolfo Valladolid, resulting in her pregnancy and a cascade of dramatic conflicts involving the powerful Valladolid family.

name: Camelia, La Texana
summary: "Camelia La Texana" is the story of a naïve and beautiful young woman who tries to escape her destiny. The story begins in the 1970s when young Camelia and her mother flee one of Mexico's most dangerous capos, Don Antonio. Camelia's beauty attracts a lot of attention – jealousy from other women and infatuation on the part of many men, who fall powerless at her feet. Her mother tries to protect her from the fate that pursues her, but as she sets off in search of adventure Camelia meets the man who will be the love of her life, and also her betrayer: Emilio Varela. Emilio promises Camelia the moon and the stars, but instead he breaks her heart.

previousepisode.name: Don Antonio le confiesa a Camelia que es su padre

name: Camaleones
summary:
Camaleones is the story of Valentina and Sebastián, who are both skilled thieves. They are united when a man they call "El Amo" forces them to commit crimes in order to protect their loved ones, who are in jail. El Amo wants to outwit Augusto Ponce de León, a corrupt police chief who is in charge of the "Chameleon" case, which he has to solve if he wants to reach a position in politics and gain more and more power. Valentina and Sebastián pose as prefect and art history teacher, respectively, at San Bartolomé School, where Augusto and Francisca, his wife, are the directors and owners; it is there where their daughter Solange studies.

The school's gardener, Leónidas, is an undercover policeman who plans to put Augusto in jail for his crimes and the death of his son, since Augusto threw him off a building and made everyone believe that he had committed suicide. Leónidas develops friendships with Valentina, Sebastian, Solange and Ulises, and from the basement of the school he is planning revenge against Augusto for pretending to be something he is not. Ironically, all the main characters pretend to be someone else, hence the name Chameleons.

name: Clap!... El lugar de tus sueños
summary: CLAP stands for "el Comité de la Escuela de Artes", the Art School. It was founded by retired actress Ofelia because long time ago she didn't support her own daughter when she wanted to follow in her footsteps; now she's trying to correct this mistake by supporting young talent. This year, childhood friends Valentinna, Montserrat, and Helena have come to CLAP, although Helena's mother is against it. Montserrat's brother Tomas, who is in love with Helena, goes with them. In Mexico City they meet Fabricio, who lives in the same hotel and wants to study at CLAP; he never talks about his past or parents. There is also Juan Pablo, who has lived with Padre Constantino since he was abandoned in the church; he directs the church choir, and he will fall in love with Valentina. There are many other personages and students of CLAP. This is basically another teen novela about their problems, love, and friendship.

name: Código postal
summary: The story is set in Acapulco, Mexico, in an exclusive gated community where a diverse group of young neighbors and friends lives. The series follows their intertwined lives, focusing on romance, friendship, family conflicts, and personal struggles. Like many Televisa youth dramas, it blends love, suspense, and emotional challenges while exploring the characters' dreams and relationships.

name: Corazón Guerrero
summary: Jesus and his two siblings are forcefully split up and given up for adoption following the sudden death of their father. When Jesus grows up, he goes on a mission to find his younger brothers and successfully reunites them. Together, before their father's grave, they vow to destroy Augusto Ruiz Montalvo, the man behind their father's death who took everything from them. Their vengeance will be aimed at Augusto's three daughters without suspecting that love will hinder the promise they made.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Es tiempo de hacer lo correcto

name: Contigo Sí
summary: Ángela, an innocent nurse and medical student from a remote town, is seduced by Álvaro, an ambitious young man, who marries her and leaves her to return to the city and trickily remarry Samanta Vega, the daughter of his boss. in a marriage of convenience. Ángela goes to look for him in Mexico City, discovers the deceit, and they divorce; she meets Leonardo, a young doctor who falls in love with her and becomes her protector.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Trabajar por nuestro sueño

name: Cannon and Ball's Casino
summary: Cannon and Ball's Casino brings the comedy duo Tommy Cannon and Bobby Ball to a casino-themed studio where humour, music and light-hearted competition meet. Each episode mixes sketches and guest performances with quiz rounds for couples hoping to win prizes, all delivered with the duo's trademark cheeky warmth and playful chaos.

name: Greyhound
summary: Thrilling WWII stories of Captain Ernest Krause inspired by actual events.

name: Cuando me enamoro
summary: Renata, a spirited woman, is treated cruelly by her mother and sister. Falling in love with Jerónimo changes her life for the better, but his misguided quest to avenge his brother's death jeopardizes their relationship.

name: Diseñando tu amor
summary:
Valentina dreams of making it in the world of fashion. She lives with her father and her sister, Nora, whom she regards as her best friend, but Nora is deeply jealous of her. Valentina is Ricardo's girlfriend, who only intends to use her to steal her father's money.

A terrible accident takes away what Valentina loves the most: her fiancé and her father. Completely devastated, the sisters move to the city where they meet Claudio. Nora immediately tries to seduce him, but he and Valentina have fallen in love. Both will have to fight for their love and defeat all the challenges ahead of them.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Que el amor te acompañe hoy y siempre

name: Duelo de Pasiones
summary: The plot follows wealthy landowner Álvaro Montellano, who, deceived by a forged letter suggesting his daughter Alina is not his biological child, banishes her and her mother Soledad to live as outcasts in the wilderness. Alina, unaware of her true parentage, falls in love with the honorable military officer Emilio Valtierra, but their romance is thwarted by misunderstandings, including Emilio being led to believe Alina has died. As secrets unravel, involving Álvaro's scheming accomplice and Emilio's manipulative former lover, the story explores themes of familial bonds, vengeance, and passionate duels of the heart amid escalating conflicts.

name: Hit Man
summary: Hit Man was a short-lived NBC daytime game show from early 1983 that blended trivia with strategy. Contestants first watched brief documentary-style film clips, then faced questions drawn from what they'd just seen — rewarding sharp attention and quick recall rather than general knowledge. Players competed across multiple rounds to "eliminate" opponents by claiming spaces on a game board, with the final winner moving on to a bonus game for a cash prize. Hosted by Peter Tomarken, the show ran on weekdays at 11:30 AM Eastern and packed its competition and quiz elements into a brisk half-hour format.

name: El Clon
summary: The telenovela tells the story of Jade and Lucas. Jade is a young woman of Arab descent, who is supposed to live with her father's family in Morocco after the death of her mother. Lucas is a young romantic, and son of a powerful businessman. When Lucas is on vacation in Morocco, he meets Jade, and the two of them fall in love. However, cultural differences will not allow them to be together. While they seek ways to realize their love, a pre-written destiny changes their lives forever.

name: El Maleficio
summary: Beatriz Almazan, a widow with a generous heart, dedicates herself to raising her two children after her husband's death. Her life turns mysterious and terrifying when she meets the powerful millionaire Enrique de Martino, whom she agrees to marry. After moving to De Martino's house, Beatriz discovers that her new husband is a sorcerer who worships a diabolical entity and has resorted to black magic to amass his immense fortune. He will fight for Beatriz's love, only to realize that the curse from which no one can escape is love itself.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Ya sé dominar el miedo

name: El Amor No Tiene Precio
summary: The story follows María Liz, a hardworking nurse living in a poor neighborhood in Mexico City. She supports her boyfriend, Marcelo, who is studying engineering but is secretly selfish and ambitious. María Liz's life changes when she meets Sebastián, a wealthy civil engineer who despises the superficial world of his mother, Doña Lucrecia.

name: Cualqier parecido
summary: Carlota, who, after separating from the person she thought was the love of her life, discovers that the saying "happily ever after" is not always true, but that doesn't mean she can't be happy.

name: El privilegio de amar
summary: El privilegio de amar follows Luciana, a successful fashion designer who is haunted by the decision she made as a young maid to abandon her daughter, Cristina, following a forbidden affair with a seminary student. Two decades later, an adult Cristina enters Luciana's fashion house to pursue a modeling career, leading to a volatile relationship where neither is aware of their biological bond. As Cristina falls in love with Luciana's stepson, Víctor Manuel, and faces sabotage from rivals, the story culminates in the eventual discovery of her true parentage and Luciana's quest for redemption.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: El amor más grande

name: En nombre del amor
summary: After her parents die in a car accident, the young and sweet Paloma is taken in by her single aunts. Macarena soon takes a liking to her niece and treats her like a daughter, while Carlota is oppressive, wanting to keep Paloma under her clutches.

name: En tierras salvajes
summary: A married couple moves from the big city to their home in a small town after the wife suffers from a lung problem. However, the presence of her husband's brothers at their home leads to complications.

name: Entre el amor y el odio
summary: Lisa and Tanya fall in love with their classmate Paul, which causes a rift between them. However, when a pregnant Tanya is killed before her wedding, Paul takes Lisa's help to overcome the trauma.

name: El Juramento
summary: El Juramento follows Santiago de Landeros as he seeks to avenge his brother Diego's suicide by finding the woman who broke his heart, known only by a necklace and the initial "A". His quest leads him to the Robles Conde family, where the manipulative Alma deceives him into believing her virtuous cousin, Andrea, is the culprit. Driven by his oath of revenge, Santiago seduces and marries Andrea with the intention of making her life a living hell at his remote hacienda, only to find himself falling deeply in love with her as she desperately tries to prove her innocence. The truth eventually emerges that Alma was the real "gold-digger" who drove Diego to his death, forcing Santiago to beg for Andrea's forgiveness and fight to save their marriage from further external schemes.

name: Hitman
summary: Adapted from the American format, Hitman is a memory-based quiz show in which Nick Owen guides contestants through a series of rounds built around specially-produced filmed inserts. After watching short feature clips on a range of topics, players must recall specific details and answer questions under pressure, with accuracy and attention to detail deciding who advances to the final game and who leaves empty-handed.

name: El derecho de nacer
summary: Two people meet on the streets of the city, London. Later, they develop an unlikely friendship. Will they manage to be friends for long?

name: The Claudia Winkleman Show
summary: Good vibes, great guests, glorious fringe. Your weekly dose of Claudia‑powered joy, as she has a chat with Hollywood stars, the best of British and her gorgeous studio audience.

name: Fuego Ardiente
summary:
Dante Ferrer has just learned that he will soon die as he is terminally ill, so he decides to gather the whole family together and feels the urge to sort out his affairs and spend the rest of his life in his family's company. 

Upon reuniting with the Ferrer family, passions run wild, mostly due to Alexa and Gabriel's unexpected forbidden romance and their discovery that the illicit counterfeiting of banknotes lies behind the family's olive oil production business.

name: Fuego en la Sangre
summary: Fuego en la Sangre is about the Reyes brothers (Juan, Oscar, Franco) who seek to avenge the death of their sister Libia, falling in love with the Elizondo sisters in the process, unleashing a war of passions, secrets, and family conflicts on a ranch controlled by an evil mother and son-in-law, transforming their revenge into forbidden love.

name: Fugitivas
summary: Four women, Lorena, Lisset, Frida, and Montse, are serving sentences in prison. Lorena, unjustly accused, joins a mass escape led by Lisset. Together, they take refuge in a bar, facing a life on the run. With the help of lawyer Alejandro Castillo and her companions, Lorena seeks to clear her name and find the true culprit, while navigating a path filled with love and betrayal in her quest for justice.

name: Smosh Mouth
summary: Join Shayne Topp (short), Amanda Lehan-Canto (tall), and a rotating Smosh friend as we discuss what's on our minds, what we've found on the internet, and other dumb ideas we're cooking up.

name: Golpe de Suerte
summary: The story of three families that win a million-dollar prize. The first family, Brenda, Tony, and their younger brother, yearn to break free from their cruel stepmother. However, being underage, they can't claim the prize themselves. The second family, single mother Miranda and her son Diego, dreams of buying a house and independent. The third family, the Pérezes, led by Nacho, has a special bond with the Teporingos Neza soccer team and aims to take them to the premier division. Yet, all face the greed of a corrupt financial advisor Dante Ferrer. Money transforms their lives, unveiling unexpected challenges. As they strive to overcome these obstacles, they discover that love and unity are vital for regaining happiness amid fortune and adversity.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Nacho, puedes besar a tu esposa

name: Heridas de Amor
summary: Heridas de Amor revolves around Miranda San Llorente, a modern, wealthy young woman whose destiny is tragically intertwined with forbidden love and family drama when her father is murdered and she is forced into a marriage of convenience with a man who hates her, unleashing tumultuous passion, revenge, and secrets on a ranch as she discovers painful truths about her past and true love.

name: Huracán
summary: In Mazatlán, Elena, an illegitimate daughter of a rich man, falls for poor Ulises. Despite obstacles, their love endures as she becomes a biologist and he, a sailor. Reuniting years later, jealous rivals try to keep them apart.

name: Inocente de Ti
summary: A naive young Mexican woman, Florecita, journeys to Miami with her family, facing hardships like her grandmother's death in the desert, only to find her father is an alcoholic, all while falling in love with the charming Julio Alberto, a man who becomes entangled in her dramatic new life amidst secrets and family struggles in the U.S..

name: Juro que Te Amo
summary: Juro que te amo is a Mexican telenovela about the Madrigal family, who lose their fortune and face social hypocrisy, forcing the young protagonist, Violeta, to fight against adversity and heartbreak with the ambitious Max, while a more noble man, José María, vies for her heart, all while she moves to the capital and deals with humiliation and family secrets, learning that love and money are not the same thing.

name: La Esposa Virgen
summary: La Esposa Virgen focuses on Virginia, a young woman who, in order to protect her family and fulfill a promise, marries a wealthy landowner, Fernando, as a virgin. He despises her and accuses her of being an adventuress, unleashing a drama of passion, deception, and redemption amid intrigues over his fortune, where true love will slowly blossom against all odds.

name: Meghan
summary: How a strong ambitious streak propels Meghan Markle onto the global stage and on a collision course with the British royal family - from her role in the hit legal drama Suits to a date that changes everything.

name: La Herencía
summary: When Don Severiano dies, his five adopted children discover they have a "sister" named Sara Del Monte Portillo- Severiano's only biological child conceived from an affair. Sara grew up believing that her father never cared about her. The arrival of the young woman will turn the lives of the Del Monte brother's upside down not only because their inheritance is in danger but also because one of them is strongly attracted to Sara and is engaged to another woman.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo final: Siempre triunfa el amor

name: Reincarnated as a Dragon Hatchling
summary: Our hero wakes up one day in a brand new world…but his new life doesn't come with fighting skills or magic powers, or even arms and legs! He's reborn as a helpless egg, stuck in an unfamiliar forest surrounded by terrifying, hungry beasts. But eggs hatch, hatchlings grow up, and humble beginnings can lead to something great. He'll do his best to become the strongest dragon ever, and no measly shell will get in his way!

previousepisode.name: I Looked to the Sky and Saw a Hero

name: La Jefa
summary: Gloria Guzmán, a woman who appeared to have it all: a successful career, a cherished son, and a loving family. On what is supposed to be the happiest day of her life, marrying the father of her son, the celebration turns into tragedy when a group of hitmen bursts into the ceremony and kills her groom. Gloria not only loses her great love, but her family also turns their back on her, the government seizes all her assets, the media points fingers at her, and her husband's enemies pursue her, demanding payment for dirty deals she was unaware of. In her fight for survival, she is mentored by top crime bosses, whom she must win over by using her two most dangerous weapons: her intelligence and her beauty.

name: The Million Pound Shaman Scam
summary: In the wealthy London suburb of Hampstead, residents are scammed out of a million pounds by a prolific fraudster who masquerades as a shaman.

name: La Jefa del Campeón
summary: This is the story of an exemplary mother, with the HEART OF A CHAMPION, who always fights for her own against long odds and external challenges. She will not rest until her son is a soccer star.

name: La Mexicana y El Güero
summary:
Professional con artist, Andrea, draws on her beauty, intelligence and charm to dupe her victims. She sets up a master plan to trick Tyler, an American millionaire searching for his birth mother. Andrea approaches him claiming to be his sister and telling him his real mother is eager to see him, and so is his whole family. Things become complicated as the "family" members experience crises compromising the charade. 

Andrea's wit helps her bridge such events, but as she falls in love with her victim, Tyler Somers, she is confronted with the dilemma of either giving up on her plan or on her love.

name: La Malquerida
summary: The story of Acacia Benavente, a girl who loses her father Alonso in an accident while he was riding his horse. When her mother Cristina finds love again after being widowed for just a year, Acacia is enraged and leaves the ranch in which they live in to go live with her grandparents. She returns 12 years later, now a stunningly beautiful young woman and without her realizing it, awakens in Esteban, her stepfather, a deep and passionate desire.

name: La Otra
summary: On a dark, stormy night, Bernarda, Leopoldo Guillen's lover, takes her two small daughters, Eugenia and Carlota, to his funeral. Leopold's son, Roman, his wife, and the priest tell them that they are unwelcome at the funeral and Roman throws them out in the mud. Years later, Carlota and Eugenia are attending a university where Carlota studies music and Eugenia studies accounting. Bernarda favors and expects the best out of Eugenia, who is failing school. However, she disdains and expects the worst out of Carlota, whom Bernarda calls "inutil" (good-for-nothing).

name: La Que No Podía Amar
summary: La que no podía amar is about Ana Paula, a young nurse who, to save her brother from prison, marries the crippled millionaire Rogelio Montero, a bitter and temperamental man, finding herself caught up in a marriage of convenience full of drama, pain, and a complicated love that defies her will, while she is torn between her duty and a new love with a handsome engineer named Gustavo, unleashing an intense war of passions and secrets on the estate.

name: La Sombra del Pasado
summary: La Sombra del Pasado tells the story about the forbidden love between Aldonza and Cristóbal, whose rival families violently separate them after a rape, forcing them to fight against hatred, revenge, and ambition for their love to triumph.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 3 - El lugar de cada quien

name: La Tempestad
summary: A wronged executive, Marina, seeking refuge and work in a small fishing town, clashes with and falls for the charismatic boat captain Damián, as they fight powerful enemies, including a human trafficking ring, while uncovering secrets about her past and discovering a deep love amidst danger and betrayal

name: La Traición
summary: This romantic saga features Hugo de Medina, a handsome, mysterious swordsman, with a reputation as a womanizer. His life crashes around him when he finds he suffers from catalepsy, an incurable condition marked by loss of voluntary motion. The same disease felled his father years before. This dashing young man meets Soledad de Obregon, a gorgeous, refined girl and the two are bound together by sudden passion, though matters are complicated by Hugo's desire to hide his infirmity.[3] As the adoring couple prepares to marry, tragedy strikes again.[4] Hugo's sinister brother, Alcides, who has always been in love with Soledad, betrays him and steals his betrothed. The rest of the telenovela deals with first Hugo's quest for vengeance and then his attempts to regain the trust and love of Soledad.

name: Los Parientes Pobres
summary: Two families, the Santos and the Olmos, face a fight of power, ambitions, selfishness and love. The Santos are provincial family that has a pottery factory with financial problems, which Ramiro Santos (Rogelio Guerra) manages along with his cousin Evaristo Olmos (Joaquín Cordero). However, this business deal finishes due to personal differences, this provokes the rancor and hate of Ramiro, and his family goes into bankruptcy, while Evaristo Olmos achieves an excellent status. When Ramiro dies, his family moves to the capital, hoping for a good fortune. But destiny will set a trap, when Evaristo offers his house for them to live, here his family treat them very bad, with contempt and haughtiness because they are the poor relatives.

name: Los Exitosos Pérez
summary: Ride along with the ups and downs of these notorious news anchors who get married as a publicity stunt.

name: Laberintos de Pasión
summary: When they were children, Julieta and the brothers Pedro and Cristóbal Valencia were friends, but Genaro owner of "The Castle" and the boys' father, pulled them apart. The painter Gabriel Almada takes care of little Julieta when her grandfather dies. They leave the region and over the years she becomes a brilliant doctor. Moved by nostalgia, she decides to return to San Vicente, her hometown, and practice her profession there. Gabriel accompanies her, but their return revives passions from the past. Genaro's hatred towards Gabriel is reborn, because he always knew that the painter was the true love of his wife, Sofía This hatred is shared by Pedro, who once saw Gabriel kissing his mother. Genaro brings his niece, Nadia to "The Castle" with the idea of solving his financial problems through the fortune that the young woman has inherited. On her side, Julieta discovers that her childhood friendship with Pedro has turned into a mature and well-requited love. But they are separated by Nadia, who has set her sights on him. Julieta, alone and hurt, takes refuge in Gabriel, but he has fallen in love with her. Julieta finds herself between two conflicting emotions: her strong passion for Pedro and the peaceful and secure love that Gabriel offers her. Now, Julieta must choose between two loves

name: Ladrón de Corazónes
summary: An intense story of passion, action and drama about two polar opposite individuals who find love in an unexpected place. Gustavo Velasco comes from a crime family that carries out high-end thefts, sharing their pickings with those who need it most a la Robin Hood. Veronica Vega comes from a family that represents law and order, and her determination to carry out that legacy leads her to Gustavo's arrest. Upon their encounter, a strong attraction and overwhelming passion that overlooks all the obstacles lying before them builds, changing their lives forever.

name: Playboy's Really Naked Truth
summary: Watch the hilarious reactions of real men unexpectedly confronted by totally naked women in the strangest places in this hysterical Playboy series.

previousepisode.name: The Best of the Really Naked Truth

name: Madre Luna
summary: This romantic melodrama features Alejandra Aguirre, a gorgeous, tenacious woman with an amazingly well-preserved body. She grows rice in the rural town of Castellón-and hides a deep, shocking secret. She is a 50-year-old woman with great passion, sensuality, and splendor. Her self-willed intensity puts her in the middle of a rivalry between Leonardo Cisneros and his handsome, daring son Ángel. Both dashing men want to possess this vivacious heroine.

name: Mañana Es Para Siempre
summary: Mañana Es Para Siempre is about Eduardo Cruz, who seeks revenge against the Elizalde family for a tragic past orchestrated by the evil Rebeca (Bárbara Greco), trained by the villain Artemio Bravo, while fighting for his love with Fernanda Elizalde, who is separated from him by Rebeca's intrigues. Eduardo develops a secret identity to infiltrate and destroy his enemies from within, facing deception, blackmail, and forbidden love.

name: Marea de Pasiones
summary: Luisa and Marcelo are a happy couple until her father, Alejandro, is murdered by Zaid, his best friend. Zaid blames Marcelo for the crime and kidnaps him with the help of some guerrillas. Luisa becomes pregnant with Marcelo's child but marries Zaid, who offers her protection and love. Seven years later, Marcelo escapes and returns to Nayarit to reclaim his family and prove his innocence. Zaid will do everything possible to prevent Marcelo from getting close to Luisa and their daughter Natalia, who is the result of her love with Marcelo.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Nunca perdimos la esperanza

name: Me Atrevo a Amarte
summary:
Love blooms between Victoria and Alejandro, set against the backdrop of a tragic and vengeful past. Years ago, Fernando Pérez-Soler orchestrated the persecution of Alejandro's family, resulting in his mother's death and the presumed loss of his newborn cousin. Forced to flee with his aunt Deborah, Alejandro returns twenty-five years later, driven by a thirst for justice.

Unaware of the truth, Alejandro falls deeply in love with Victoria, never suspecting that her family is responsible for his suffering. Torn between the need for vengeance and his growing feelings for her, he faces a heart-wrenching decision: carry out his plan for revenge or surrender to the love he's found, all while confronting the painful truth that stands between them.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Mi deber es protegerte

name: Mi Amor Sin Tiempo
summary:
The Uriarte family faces tensions when Greta, dissatisfied in her marriage, reconnects with a past love, causing family division. Her favoritism towards Bárbara and Pablo creates opposing sides with Fátima and Gonzalo. Bárbara, obsessed with becoming a mother again, falls in love with Daniel, her husband Mario's cousin, leading to betrayal and conflicts. Fátima, the youngest, realizes her engagement to Adrián isn't true love when she meets Sebastián, who steals her heart.

These three women confront deep emotional conflicts that test their values, ethics, and priorities, discovering that true love is timeless.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Estamos más unidos que nunca

name: Mi Camino es Amarte
summary:
Memo is a self-respecting man, with a seemingly settled life. He wants to build a home next to Úrsula, but receiving a letter containing the confession that he has a daughter changes completely the course of his life. Without expecting it, this sudden detour will lead him to love, since, trying to meet little Isabella, he arrives at the Beltrán family's house where he meets Daniela, Isabella's adoptive mother, becoming her confidant and little by little they fall in love. 

A story that proves that your destination may change its path.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: El amor nunca termina

name: Mi Fortuna Es Amarte
summary:
Natalia and Adrian are celebrating their twentieth-anniversary party, with their family and closest friends. Adrian and Natalia's best friend Veronica have hatched a plan to flee on the same day of the celebration and once they have swindled the clients of the real estate agency of which they are partners. 

Meanwhile, Vicente is a victim of fraud and loses everything. Natalia is left with only one house in a popular neighborhood where she must move in with her daughters. When she arrives, she finds out that Vicente is the supposed owner of the house since he signed an invalid sales contract, which makes Natalia the actual owner. Vicente refuses to receive them and Natalia, without hesitating, moves into the house that both will now share with their respective families, causing conflicts between the characters due to social and cultural differences.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Llenos de amor

name: Mi Pecado
summary: Mi Pecado revolves around the reunion of Lucrecia and Julián, childhood friends whose love is thwarted by their families and grudges, forcing Lucrecia to marry another man to save her father, while Julián is unjustly accused and flees, condemned to fight against obstacles, secrets, and fate to be together, against the backdrop of the rivalry between the Huerta and Córdoba families in the town of El Milagro, a love that is their "sin" and salvation.

name: Mi Secreto
summary:
What would you do if you lost everything, and life gives you an opportunity to reinvent yourself and take on a new identity. Valeria and Natalia, two little girls that met at a boarding school are bound by their family's abandonment, which brings them together until both suffer a terrible accident where Valeria is the sole survivor. 

She must run away, and all she manages to take with her are Natalia's ID documents; she decides to steal her friend's identity without considering the challenges that will come with her new life.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Vamos a vivir nuestro amor

name: Minas de Pasión
summary:
Emilia Sánchez is a single and resilient mother who works in a mine, where she meets with Leonardo Santamaría, the son of the town's most powerful woman, Roberta Castro. Emilia and Leonardo fall in love, unleashing Roberta's fury. As Roberta discovers that Emilia has exposed her wicked deeds, she seeks revenge to make Emilia's life miserable and destroy her. Emilia survives the hardships but is left with a broken heart, believing Leonardo betrayed her. 

When everyone believes Emilia has died, she returns to the town to reclaim her son and seek justice. She will make each of her enemies pay for the harm they've inflicted, discovering that love is her only salvation.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Emilia y Leonardo, juntos para siempre

name: Mujer de Nadie
summary:
An innocent young woman committed to caring for her ailing father finds herself helpless after he dies. Her scheming godmother and aunt use her to get rich at all costs. Powerful men desire her obsessively, and even the people she trusts, they all use her to reach their own ambitions.
Upon discovering the betrayal of the man she loved, and after she lost her daughter at birth, Lucía transforms into a woman with only one purpose in mind, to use her beauty to take revenge on all the men who hurt her.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: El motor de mi vida

name: Mundo de Fieras
summary: Mundo de Fieras focuses on Gabriel, a man from high society who marries the manipulative Joselyn and suffers from her cruelty, until the arrival of the humble tutor Mariángela awakens his love and unleashes his wife's fury, while his twin brother Demián, raised in poverty, seeks revenge against him, revealing a world of passions, intrigues, and fierce creatures in the Bustamante family and its surroundings.

name: Mentir para Vivir
summary: Oriana Caligaris, is happily married to Jose Luis Falcon. They live next to their daughter Alina, in Cartagena, Colombia. All of a sudden, one day everything changes for Oriana when Jose Luis, who works at the Colombian Customs, confesses to her that he has been doing some smuggling activities, and the police are already behind him since he put the earnings he made out of this under her name without her consent, thus, involving her in the business. Disappointed, Oriana escapes to Mexico with her daughter, and looks for her intimate friend Raquel, who owns "El Descanso" hotel in San Carlos, Sonora, together with Lucina. Oriana will have to struggle with her past and her new life.

name: Mi Destino Eres Tu
summary: Mi Destino Eres Tú is about Andrea, a young woman who, after the tragic death of her beloved husband Ramiro, closes her heart and devotes herself to work, but her destiny forces her to open up to love again when two men, Mauricio and Eduardo, enter her life, one of whom is destined to be her true love, despite the pain and guilt she feels.

name: Mujeres Engañadas
summary: Yolanda and Javier have been happily married for 17 years and have 2 daughters. But Yolanda doesn't know that Javier is having an affair. Sadly, Yolanda is far from the only woman with that problem.

name: Terror Man
summary: Min Jung Woo has a special ability, one that lets him see whenever a path leads to an unfortunate future. He uses his eyes of "Misfortune" to spot unfortunate events and tries to stop them, leading him to become a terrorist feared by the people.

name: Smosh Summer and Winter Games
summary: "Smosh Summer and Winter Games" formerly titled, "Smosh Seasonal Games" is an event and series of videos uploaded on the Smosh Games and Smosh Pit channels. It sees the entire Smosh Family divide into teams to compete against each other in season related games.

name: Smosh Babies
summary: Before Ian and Anthony were stupid adults, they were even stupider babies!

name: URL | SmoshAlike
summary: Courtney Miller interviews famous internet people in order to find out just how Internet-savvy they truly are.

previousepisode.name: Anthony Got Monét X Change Eliminated

name: Lunchtime with Smosh: The Podcast
summary: Grab your favorite snack and join Anthony Padilla, Ian Hecox and their Gen Z producer on their lunch break to chat about who knows what!

previousepisode.name: We Threw Arasha the Worst Birthday Party

name: Super Smosh
summary: Ian and Anthony can harness the power of any video game they own - and they might just be the key to saving the planet! Follow their adventures every other Friday only on Shut Up! Cartoons!

name: Nadie Como Tú
summary: The story of Ximena and Salvador, two young souls driven by a thirst for justice, their destinies entwined by this common pursuit. Ximena, a mezcal producer presumed dead since childhood, uncovers her true heritage within a family that views her as an adversary. Salvador, an esteemed attorney bound by ethical principles, is the heir to the family that once raised her as a servant, and he finds himself falling deeply in love with her. As her origin is revealed, animosity between the mezcal families resurfaces, separating Ximena and Salvador.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Te prometo una vida juntos, Ximena

name: Niña Amada Mía
summary: Niña Amada Mía tells the story of Isabela Soriano, a young woman who falls in love with her foreman, Víctor Izaguirre, a forbidden love that defies the strict rules of her father, Clemente Soriano, a controlling rancher who tries to marry her off to a rich man to save the estate, unleashing a whirlwind of passion, secrets, and family conflicts in a rural setting.

name: Niña de Mi Corazón
summary: Niña de Mi Corazón revolves around Andrea Paz, a young woman who abandons her dreams of going to college to support her family after her father's accident. She becomes entangled in a plot involving identity and romance when she pretends to be a man to work at a company, falling in love with the wealthy heir Darío Arrioja, who mistakes her for a boy while she struggles to protect her secret and her growing love for him.

name: Quiero Amarte
summary: Mauro Montesinos is a widower and owner of a coffee plantation. He falls in love with Florencia Martinez, the owner of some coffee lands next to his plantation. However, the love between Mauro and Florencia is impossible because when they are about to marry, Mauro discovers that Lucrecia, an old friend of his, is pregnant with his child. Mauro and Florencia must separate despite their big love. Thirty years pass, and Florencia and Mauro´s past is brought back to life when Maximiliano Montesino, (Mauro´s son) falls in love with Amaya, Florencia´s daughter. Both must fight against many hardships in order to discovery if their love is stronger than the unfortunate past lived by their parents.

name: Pasión Prohibida
summary: The plot centers on Bianca, a young woman harboring deep resentment toward her mother, Flavia Fischer, whom she blames for her father's death; to exact revenge, Bianca marries Ariel Piamonte, Flavia's wealthy husband, and moves into the family estate, where she unexpectedly falls in love with Bruno, Ariel's nephew and the fiancé of her half-sister Penélope. This forbidden romance unfolds amid escalating tensions, including hidden affairs, a shocking pregnancy, and dramatic confrontations that test loyalties and unravel the family's facade of perfection.

name: Pecados Ajenos
summary: Natalia and Adrián are strangers who live in different cities but discover in an instant that they belong together. They were both married for over twenty years, and each has two beautiful young children. Their lives are quite similar—and both are unhappy and frustrated. Destiny brings the two together when they are each on the verge of divorce.

name: Querida Enemiga
summary: Lorena and Sara were raised together in an orphanage, and even though they have different personalities, they loved each other as sisters. Lorena dreams of starting her own family and loves to cook, while Sara is more materialistic; she has always hated the poverty of the orphanage, and she has more ambitions than values. Lorena's greatest wish is to become a chef and so, one day she says goodbye to the nuns who raised her at the orphanage and leaves to study cuisine in Mexico City. That same day, Madre Asunción discovers that Sara had stolen some of the funds of the orphanage. However, after she confronts Sara, she suffers a heart attack and dies. To avoid getting caught any further, Sara runs with her lover and accomplice Chalo, who is also the delivery guy/driver of the orphanage. But before she leaves, she goes through the files Madre Asunción had in her office for each orphaned child and stole two files – hers and Lorena's. When she finally reads them, she learns that she was found in the garbage dump, while Lorena was abandoned in the orphanage without explanation by her grandmother, the millionaire Hortensia Vallejo Vda. de Armendáriz. Sara's first impulse is to find Lorena and help her confront her grandmother and demand her rights, but then she reconsiders her options and decides to usurp her place in the Armendáriz gastronomic empire. Believing she would never see Lorena again, Sara thought her plan was foolproof.

name: Perdona Nuestros Pecados
summary: The love Elsa and Andres feel for each other is pure and selfless, but it is forbidden. Elsa's father, Armando Quiroga, the wealthiest man in town, whom everyone looks up to, will do everything he can to prevent their love. He believes dating between social classes is unacceptable- it goes against his ideals. In their quest for happiness, Elsa and Andres will challenge societal norms and free themselves from the oppressive grip of their families.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: No puedes escapar de tu destino

name: Pasión
summary: Set in colonial Mexico during the 1740s, Pasión is an epic period drama that follows the arduous love story between Camila Darién and Ricardo de Salamanca. After being separated from her true love, Santiago, and enduring various misfortunes—including being kidnapped by pirates—Camila finds herself entangled with the rugged pirate Ricardo, who is on a quest to reclaim his family's lost fortune. As they navigate a world of sea battles, class struggles, and betrayal, the two must overcome their initial differences and the machinations of their enemies to find a future together, proving that passion can conquer even the most remarkable obstacles.

name: Palabra de Mujer
summary: Palabra de Mujer focuses on four women from different social classes (Vanesa, Fernanda, Paulina, and Matilde) who come together to face personal and professional challenges, discovering their strength, overcoming romantic disappointments, and seeking personal fulfillment through friendship and empowerment, all while managing complex relationships and fighting for their dreams in a challenging work environment, such as a television production company.

name: The David Niven Show
summary: Dramatic anthology with David Niven as host

name: Pienso en Ti
summary:
Emilia is a woman who, against her mother's will, confronts everything and everyone to pursue her dream of succeeding as a singer. She has a beautiful voice that immediately connects with people and the talent to put music to the words that come from her heart. Although her mother was the one who taught her how to sing, she forbade her from doing it professionally, believing that those who enter that world, full of vices and easy ways, get lost.

When Emilia meets Angel, her idol, she finds the strength to pursue her dream without realizing that her voice will give him hope and life. Angel will give her wings and Emilia strength. Still, they must face many obstacles to materialize their love and survive between love and fame.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: El amor sana cualquier herida

name: Ojo por Ojo
summary: The Barragán and Monsalve families are cousins but enmity under a blood and revenge sentence provoked by Nando when killing his cousin Adriano. Only Arcangel Barragan and Nadia Monsalve with their love can change all.

name: Pueblo Chico Infierno Grande
summary: Wealthy, 35 year-old longtime widow Leonarda Ruán & new guy in town, 20 year-old Genaro Onchi, with nothing to his name, unexpectedly fall deeply in love with each other. Their love is challenged by the very strong disapproval of the small, close-minded conservative town and by two men & three women who each intend to win over Leonarda & Genaro respectively.

name: Ramona
summary: Ramona returns to the family home after years of being educated by nuns. Ramona reunites with her mother and brother and childhood friend, the Indian Alejandro. Ramona and Alejandro fall in love and the couple are faced with the prejudices of an interracial couple.

name: Ni Contigo, Ni Sin Ti
summary: Ni Contigo, Ni Sin Ti  is about Leo, a blind but optimistic man, and Nicole, a resilient woman fleeing a hurricane, who find love in a boarding house filled with quirky tenants; their developing romance faces challenges from societal prejudices, personal secrets, and the meddling of a charming womanizer, Jose Carlos, who becomes obsessed with Nicole, forcing everyone to confront their fears and fight for a love that seems impossible.

name: Ringo
summary: Ringo tells the story about a retired boxer, Juan José "Ringo" Ramírez, who must return to the ring and fight for custody of his son against his ex-wife and rival, facing economic hardship and personal battles outside the ropes to prove he's a champion in life as well as boxing

name: Sed de Venganza
summary: Fernanda Ríos, determined to move past her troubled past, has her plans disrupted when a cruel man enters her life, sparking a chain of events testing her resilience. Complicating matters, she falls for Francisco, driven by vengeance.

name: Peregrina
summary: Peregrina is a love story full of magic and risks taken to achieve happiness. A tragedy befalls the home of millionaire Eliseo: his daughter, Marisela, whom he loves immensely, suffers from a deadly disease. In the little time left to live, Marisela becomes pregnant and, before she dies, gives birth to a baby girl.

name: Piel de Otoño
summary: A woman in Mexico mistreated and abused by her husband abandons him, and goes to Spain where she falls in love and has an affair with another man.

name: Sin Tu Mirada
summary: Sin Tu Mirada focuses on Marina, a humble young blind woman who develops great sensitivity and falls in love with the wealthy Luis Alberto, facing obstacles due to her disability, her social class, and the intricate secrets of her origins, as she was switched at birth with the son of a wealthy family to ensure a male heir for the Ocaranza family, in a plot of love, prejudice, and destiny.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: La mejor noticia

name: Por Siempre Mi Amor
summary:
Arturo De La Riva has been happily married to Eugenia for 10 years, with whom he has a daughter, named Aranza, however, they do not imagine that Eugenia´s cousin Sonia, is obsessively in love with Arthur in secret, leading her to cause a terrible tragedy. Meanwhile, Isabel Lopez Cerdan spent two years believing she was married to Fernando Cordova, whom she loves above all everything.

Eugenia dies unexpectedly at the same that Isabel discovers that Fernando is a scammer. After such hard blows, fate unites Isabel and Arturo on a heavenly beach, giving birth to a relationship that must defeat several hardships such as the manipulation Sonia puts on Aranza to make her reject Isabel, and Fernando´s hunger for revenge.

name: Sin Vergüenza
summary: Four friends, Renata, Maite, Paloma and Fernanda, owners of the women's underwear company "Sin vergüenza" who face love, passion, evil and friendship. They live in Bogota, Colombia.

name: Por Un Beso
summary: Tragedy surrounds Azucena's life, as her father was unjustly imprisoned and her mother murdered. The love between Azucena and Daniel will be affected by the revenge of Mariano, who will do everything possible so that they are not happy.

name: Rafaela
summary: After living in poverty, Rafaela decides to become a doctor and work at a hospital to carry on. She didn't imagine that at the hospital she would find her true love and the envy of people who never liked her.

name: S.O.S. Me Estoy Enamorando
summary:
Alberto and Sofia will live an impossible love story, as fate would have it. In order to save his generations old family business from bankruptcy, Alberto must reach an agreement with their new investors, but they have different plans in mind for the land where the printing press is. 

Things get even more complicated as Sofia is one of the new investors' daughter. He can't possibly sacrifice his legacy and she is incapable of opposing her father's decisions, so their love is at stake.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Te voy a amar toda la vida

name: Soy tu dueña
summary: Valentina Villalba Rangel is a beautiful woman who inherited a large fortune from her parents. When her fiancé Alonso Peñalvert leaves her at the altar, she swears never to let another man toy with her again.

name: Los Plateados
summary: Los Plateados were bandits who stole from the routes which transported silver to the states of Guanajuato and Taxco in Mexico. For that reason the bandits were called "the silver plated ones", which means "the silver-plated". It was the social time of the bandits, They would steal from the rich and give to the poor. This soap opera bring that era to us with plenty of excitement and romance.

name: Te doy la vida
summary:
Elena, Ernesto and Nicolás had been a happy family until Nicolás was diagnosed with leukemia and needed an urgent bone marrow transplant. Ernesto and Elena are compelled to find their son's biological parents as none of the adoptive family members are compatible with him. They are unable to find the mother, but they do find Pedro his father, instead, who is shocked by the news since he had no idea he had a son. 

Ernesto and Elena are deeply grateful to him but demand him not to have any relationship with Nicolás. He agrees, understanding that Nicolás already has a life with his adoptive family. But fate has other plans and everyone's life will change completely.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final - Parte 2: Te doy mi vida

name: Sentimientos Ajenos
summary: Sofía de la Huerta is a young and kind painter who falls in love with Renato Aramedia without imagining that her love will unleash the hatred of Leonor de la Huerta, her own sister, or that Renato is compulsively jealous.

name: Tierra de Esperanza
summary:
María Teresa, a successful and attractive businesswoman, faces a dilemma when she discovers that her father, Esteban, has been falsely accused of fraud. Determined to clear his name, María Teresa takes charge of "La Esperanza," a coveted property in the village of Puerto Bravo. There, she encounters Santos, the estate's caretaker, who initially perceives her as rude and entitled. Despite their initial differences, María Teresa and Santos join forces to confront Marco, a greedy neighbor attempting to seize control of "La Esperanza," and Rutilio, the town's corrupt mayor. 

As they battle to safeguard the estate, María Teresa and Santos gradually develop deep feelings for one another, falling in love. Amidst their challenges, their love and the hope embodied by "La Esperanza" become their guiding light in a tempest fueled by passion.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Una vida llena de amor

name: Siempre te amaré
summary: The life of a happy family is ruined as soon as Mauricio's wife is thought to be dead in a train accident when she was apparently trying to leave her husband.

name: Farma Vojty Kotka
summary: Actor, director, and producer Vojtěch Kotek is embarking on a completely new life project—not only is he building his own farm, but he is also filming a new documentary series about it.

name: Soñadoras
summary: Two stories at the same time: the first one is the love between Fernanda (a doctor) and Jose Luis (a teacher). The second one is the story of friendship of 5 schoolgirls in a private school for rich kids.

name: Tormenta en el Paraiso
summary:
In 1519, the Mayan priest Ahzac learns that his maiden daughter, Ixmy, has surrendered to the love of a white man, thus betraying her destiny, for she was fated to be sacrificed to the gods, accompanied by an offering of gold and a huge black pearl. Infuriated, Ahzac lays a terrible curse on the treasure: "May happiness never come to those who hold this black pearl in their hands!"

In 1987, while Hernan Lazcano and Eliseo Bravo are exploring the Cozumel coral reef, they make an amazing discovery. They find the black pearl, which has lain at the bottom of the sea for five centuries. When Eliseo touches the pearl, unleashing Ahzac's curse, he is suddenly possessed by an overwhelming greed, which makes him cause his partner's death. Hernan's demise will leave his wife Analy and his infant daughter Aymar in abject poverty. 

Eliseo brings the black pearl and the gold back to Veracruz, but the black pearl´s curse is upon him, and he finds his wife María Teresa gone. She has deserted him and their three sons, David, Nicolas and Leonardo.

Eliseo recovers from his pain and, with his new wealth, builds up a prosperous cattle breeding hacienda that lives up to its name: Paradise. However, he keeps the source of his fortune a secret, as well as the dark betrayal caused by the curse of that beautiful pearl.

Twenty years go by. Eliseo has raised his sons with an iron fist. His oldest son, David, turns out to be a disappointment to him, for he shows no interest in the hacienda, so Eliseo puts his trust in his second son, Nicolas, an upstanding lawyer who stands squarely behind his father. Leonardo, his youngest son, has a sensitive, melancholy disposition.

Aymar, Hernan's daughter, has grown into a beautiful young woman who is proud of her Mayan culture and ancestry. When she and Nicolas meet, they both fall deeply in love with each other.

A ravishing beauty called Maura Duran appears on the scene, passing herself off as Karina Rosemberg. Driven by greed, she weaves a web of lies to get her hands on the Bravo fortune. Using her sensual allure, she seduces the three brothers and turns them against each other. Aymar is caught in the middle of Maura's intrigue, and separated from Nicolas.

But the love between Nicolas and Aymar has not died. A long and desperate fight awaits them, against Maura's dark machinations and the curse of the black pearl, with love as their only weapon, a love capable of defeating time and evil itself.

name: Tres mujeres
summary: Three women who are torn between two loves, what society will say about them and the desire to have the man they love. Each one will find their way to happiness. There will be those who succeed and there will be those who stay on the road.

name: Tu Vida Es Mi Vida
summary: Upon discovering she has a terminal illness, Paula, a thriving businesswoman, reassesses her life. Resigning from her job, she dedicates time to her three children. Paula buys a food truck for a family adventure. Their adventure begins in a village with a family estate, sparking a clash with Pepe's family, proprietors of a local eatery. Despite initial tension, Paula and Pepe, a man of noble character, are mutually attracted. Paula's illness, buried family secrets, and challenges confronting her children navigate them through an intricate path, fortifying their love. Determined to survive, Paula opts for a complex surgery.

name: Una Maid en Manhattan
summary: Marisa, a brave and hard-working young mother, moves to New York City, following her young son's dream. While there, she lives out situations typical of all immigrants, but a twist of fate and confusion lead her to true love with Cristobal. When everything seems to start coming together for this love story to take place, the jealousy and envy of others strives to separate them. Will the strength of their love be powerful enough to help them come out unscathed from all their challenges and battles so they can declare victory once and for all?

name: Velo de Novia
summary: Velo de Novia is a telenovela about Andrea Paz, a young woman with heart disease who receives a heart transplant and falls in love with the donor's fiancé, José Manuel, while being tormented by the ghost of her lost love, Ángeles, in a two-part story that explores love, revenge, and identity with supernatural elements.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Felicidad en el altar

name: Mágica juventud
summary: A portray of the Mexican youth at the early 90s.

name: Vencer la Ausencía
summary:
Esther, Julia, Celeste and Margarita have known each other for many years and share a dream of getting ahead in life. Tragedy puts them in a vulnerable position. Esther loses her only son in an accident; Julia faces her husband's disappearance and Margarita dies, leaving María del Rayo, "Ray", orphaned. Celeste is diagnosed with a terminal disease, right at the time when she fulfills her dream of getting pregnant. 

This is how destiny is putting these four women´s resilience to the test.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: El amor se queda para toda la vida

name: Vencer la Culpa
summary: The story of four women: Manuela, Amanda, Paloma, and Yaneli; their destinies intertwine when Dulce, a young woman they barely knew, mysteriously disappears. Together they will look for Dulce without imagining that they will overcome multiple obstacles to solve the mystery. In that search, a solid friendship will develop, which will help each one overcome their guilt. Together they will discover that sorority is their greatest strength.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Eso se llama culpa

name: Vencer el Miedo
summary: Four women of different ages face current social issues and must overcome numerous hurdles, learning to conquer their greatest fears. Inés is under her husband's yoke. Cristina undergoes an abuse. Areli is starting to discover her sexuality and feels uncomprehended. Marcela steals a car, unaware that an important businessman's corpse is inside the trunk. At 15 years old, she ends up in a Juvenile Detention Center charged with robbery and being a suspect in a murder she didn't commit.

previousepisode.name: Final Parte 2: Esta historia no termina

name: Verando de Amor
summary: Verano de Amor is the story of four teenagers who have always lived in the city of Tlacotalpan, Veracruz, Mexico. The story's message emphasizes the distinction between the importance of pursuing one's dreams and the importance of pursuing material things.

name: Victorinos
summary: Three Victorinos - who were born on the same day, year, month and hour - will be united by the same fate. The day they meet in the place where they were born, one of them will die. Find out which of the three will have a tragic end!

name: Vencer el Desamor
summary:
The story of four women of different ages and social strata are forced to coexist in the same house. At first, their interaction is awkward and strained due to their different perspectives and approaches to life. 

But gradually, sorority and sympathy prevails as they realize their unique bond: somehow, they have all experienced their respective partners' absence and abandonment.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Las mujeres unidas vencen todo

name: Atrévete a Olvidárme
summary: Years ago, Gonzalo Rivas-Montaño was engaged to Olga Bocker, but when he met her sister, Elena, they fell in love. However, Olga's wickedness managed to separate them and turned the entire town against her sister. Elena died shortly after, leaving Gonzalo devastated; he eventually married Olga and they had a daughter, Hanna. In the present, Andrea Rosales is a kind and generous young woman who has lived her entire life in the small mining town of Real del Monte. At the beginning of the story, Andrea is about to marry Manuel Soto, a handsome mining engineer. However, Daniel González Rivas-Montaño, a young and idealistic journalist who never imagined he had ties to Real del Monte, arrives in town. Daniel arrives in town in search of his grandfather, Don Gonzalo Rivas-Montaño, whom he has never met. The reason is that his mother, Hanna Rivas-Montaño Bocker de González, hates his father, holding him responsible for his mother's suicide. Daniel meets Andrea and the two fall in love, leading Andrea to break off her engagement to Manuel. For many of the townspeople, their love is reminiscent of the story of Gonzalo and Elena, and it seems history is about to repeat itself

name: Последний шеф
summary:
Russian chefs will travel to Asia to test themselves in extreme conditions.

They will search for and source their own ingredients for the dishes, and ultimately prepare a dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant.

name: Hirayasumi
summary: Living in Asagaya, 29-year-old Hiroto Ikuta spends his days working at his part-time job and chatting with the locals. He likes visiting Hanae Wada most, a grumpy yet kind elderly woman whom Hiroto calls "Granny." Hiroto's time with Granny is sadly cut short when she passes away from a heart attack. To his surprise, Hiroto inherits Granny's house as she never married or had children. Three months later, 18-year-old Natsumi Kobayashi moves from her hometown to attend art school. With nowhere else to go, she stays with her cousin Hiroto, whom she has not seen in years. Despite their opposing personalities, the pair begin living under the same roof as they struggle through their seemingly mundane lives.

name: Strip Law
summary: Outlandish cases. Unconventional tactics. And a flash of razzmatazz. Las Vegas has seen it all — but it's never seen lawyering quite like this.

name: Titans of the Cold War
summary: Titans of the Cold War is an eight-part documentary series that charts the epic geopolitical struggle between The United State of America and the Soviet Union as told through the eyes of the era's most commanding figures. From World War II to the dissolution of the U.S.S.R, it centers on two titans, leaders whose choices, ideologies, and rivalries shaped the fate of the world.

previousepisode.name: The Fall of the Red Empire

name: The National Lottery: On the Spot
summary: The National Lottery: On the Spot was a lively BBC One Saturday-night game and entertainment show hosted by Des O'Connor and Suzi Perry. Filmed on location around the UK, the series brings surprise challenges, feel-good moments, and audience participation to real people "on the spot," all wrapped around the National Lottery draw.

name: Down to Earth
summary: A free-spirited woman who died back in the Roaring Twenties, now an angel looking to earn her wings, is sent to Earth in the 1980s to help the Preston family as their housekeeper after the mother's untimely death.

name: The Waiting Game
summary: Ruby Wax hosts The Waiting Game, where teams face timed trivia challenges in which patience becomes part of the strategy. The longer a contestant waits before buzzing in, the greater the potential reward — but hesitate too long and the risk increases. The show mixes quick thinking with calculated nerve, as teamwork, timing and judgement prove just as important as general-knowledge know-how.

name: Ana y los 7
summary:
The series tells the story of Ana, a young showgirl at a strip club, who dreams of making it big in show business. Ana spent her childhood in an orphanage, and her deepest desire is to have a family. She has a boyfriend, Tony, who seems to love her but is a rather useless scoundrel.

By chance, she ends up at the home of Fernando, a widowed banker with seven children, where she's mistaken for the new nanny. Ana likes the idea and decides to keep the job. The new nanny will fill the quiet of this large family with life and excitement, although at night she'll continue working on the show, secretly leading a double life.

name: Ana e os Sete
summary:
Ana e os Sete is a sitcom, designed for family entertainment, whose central theme is family, youth, and childhood conflicts. 

Henrique Vilar is a distinguished banker who became a widower about a year ago and has seven children aged between six and seventeen. Since his wife's death, he has been looking for a governess to take care of his children's education, but they are not very interested in having someone in their mother's place, always devising schemes that cause the candidates to leave after a few days.
