Ana Cruz is a very attractive woman who has always dreamed of being an actress, but has had little luck in the art of acting, despite competing in all the auditions. Advised by Tino, her best friend and long-time boyfriend, she supports herself as a stripper at the Chicago Club, where she anxiously awaits a film producer who will see her and recognise her talent. Tired of her current life and aware that her job as a stripper won't last forever, Ana goes to an employment agency where a mix-up occurs, and she's directed to the Vilar Mansion, where the 16th nanny has just left!

name: Så byggdes din stad
summary: Petra Mede takes us on a colorful journey through time through SVT's archives to some of our Swedish cities.

previousepisode.name: Västerås - en berättelse från SVT Arkiv

name: Tondera House no Daibouken
summary: Three children wander into a mysterious house that is able to travel through time. After a mishap, they find themselves in early AD. They spend the majority of series trying to return to the 20th century while stopping to interact with life in the past.

name: Toujours Canadiens
summary: Legends of the Montreal Canadiens transcend stats and trophies; three icons - an artist, warrior, and agitator - exemplify the team's spirit through their untold stories of triumph and struggle.

name: Whammy! The All-New Press Your Luck
summary: Whammy! The All-New Press Your Luck is a revival of the classic game show in which contestants answer trivia questions to earn spins on a giant game board filled with cash, prizes, and the dreaded "Whammies" — animated characters that can wipe out a player's winnings. Hosted by Todd Newton, the series keeps the original show's risk-and-reward gameplay while updating the look and pacing for a modern audience.

name: Chuck Woolery: Naturally Stoned
summary: Chuck Woolery: Naturally Stoned is a reality series that follows game show host Chuck Woolery at work and at home, offering a behind-the-scenes look at his life, career, and relationships while balancing hosting duties on Lingo with personal projects and family moments.

name: How Much Is Enough?
summary: How Much Is Enough? sees four contestants compete to win money from a shared cash meter. As the meter rises, players secretly decide when to lock in — but the longer they wait, the higher the risk that someone else will take the money first. Strategy, timing, and nerve determine who walks away with the biggest share, while the player judged to be the "greediest" leaves with nothing.

name: Les dossiers secrets de l'inspecteur Lavardin
Beat the Star
summary: Beat the Star is a game show where a member of the public competes head-to-head against a celebrity across a series of physical and mental challenges. Each round tests different skills such as coordination, endurance, strategy, or trivia knowledge, with points awarded based on performance. The contestant plays for a cash prize, while the celebrity competes for charity. The format builds tension as the rounds increase in value, leading to a high-stakes final challenge that decides the overall winner. If the contestant loses, the prize money rolls over to the next episode, increasing the potential jackpot.

name: Randling
summary: Randling is an Australian comedy panel and word-game series hosted by Andrew Denton. Two permanent teams of comedians, writers, broadcasters, and entertainers compete across a season-long tournament, facing off in a mix of wordplay challenges, linguistic puzzles, definitions, anagrams, and literary trivia. With quick wit, playful rivalry, and a warm, conversational tone, the show blends smart humor with a celebration of language, as guests test their vocabulary skills while trading jokes and storytelling.

name: An İstanbul Story
summary: Experience the drama in drama's capital. Masks fall in the heart of İstanbul's magnificent streets, where a romantic film set quickly turns into a fierce reckoning of passion, rage, and jealousy.

name: Kylmä kausi
summary: Anna, the underdog on the national team, gets the chance to train as Maria's ski partner, the enigmatic queen of skiing, and she jumps at the chance. The women are coached by the ruthless Kim, who only cares about results. Anna and Maria play a dark, psychological game where they compete against each other, but also need each other to reach the top. The closer Anna gets to the top, the higher the price of success. In the end, there can only be one winner.

name: Dynastiet Mærsk
summary: A 3-episode  drama documentary about the Danish industrialist Mærsk McKinney Møller who built the largest Danish conglomerate during the 1900's.

name: Антология технологий Яндекс Такси
summary: Does a taxi have a magic price increase button? What does the money from the driver's commission go to? Who is watching the users in the salon? And what is hidden on the other side of the application? The Yandex.Taxi team will tell you how the service's technologies work, which protect drivers and passengers, quickly assign cars to order and consider a fair price for everyone.

name: The Virgin and the Billionaire
summary: A chance encounter leads to a romance between a billionaire and a maid with a difficult fate.

name: River Sunset
summary: On the evening of March 19, 1942, an Allied aircraft carrying a covert operative known as the Believer arrived over Rangoon Airport, only to discover upon landing that the airfield had already fallen into Japanese hands. The aircraft immediately attempted to take off again, but the following day the highest authorities received an AAAA-level telegram reporting that the plane had been shot down, triggering widespread panic. The Believer's mission was to deliver an ultra-top-secret operational plan and encrypted contact codes to the supreme command of the China Theater. The authorities ordered military intelligence to locate the missing aircraft and the Believer at all costs. Carried by the Believer were the complete details of the operation, including the communication codes linking the Pacific aircraft carrier task force and the bomber squadrons assigned to carry out the strike. Should these documents fall into Japanese hands, not only would the plan to bomb Tokyo collapse, but the entire escort fleet would be left like lambs to the slaughter. Wounded, the Believer parachuted into the sea and landed on Sanzao Island, home to a Japanese Navy Sixth Air Base. There, the operative was rescued and hidden by local islanders.

name: Bone Ritual
summary: During the Republican era, bone-inspection master, Mr. Cao, and his apprentice Zheng Yu are summoned to the Wang family estate to perform a ritual examination, only to find themselves framed and ensnared in a bloody, baffling murder case. Fighting to clear their names and seek justice, master and apprentice embark on a path of retribution. What they uncover is a heart-wrenching tragedy, born of a cruel and unforgiving era.

name: Moordfeest
summary: Six Dutch celebrities solve a fictional murder, with a new theme and location each week. Both the victim and the perpetrator are also well-known Dutch people who have received an invitation.

name: House of Villains
summary: Eight notorious reality stars move into a villa where they challenge, manipulate, and sabotage each other to be crowned the ultimate Supervillain and take home the cash prize of €25,000.

name: Te land, ter zee en in de lucht Winterspecial
summary: Led by Gerard Joling and Ruben Nicolai, the participants will race down the slope in their carts in a winter wonderland atmosphere. It promises to be a true spectacle of light in the beautiful Winter Wonderland of the Efteling, full of snow, warm fires, and a large audience. The slope is steep, and their brakes will need to be strong this year, which will be made even more difficult by the thick layer of ice on the track.

name: Solo Leveling
summary: An E-rank Hunter gains extraordinary abilities after a near-death experience and becomes humanity's unexpected hope against monstrous threats.

name: Neven's English Food Tour
summary: Neven Maguire starts the new year with a new seven-part series: Neven's English Food Tour, on RTÉ One, which concentrates on the North East of England, including Newcastle, Northumberland and County Durham.

name: Any Given Day: Cork University Hospital
summary: Following staff shifts and patient journeys across the hospital. Together, they tell a bigger story of Cork University Hospital on 'any given day'.

name: Positively Yours
summary: The story of Jang Hui Won, a successful woman who prioritizes her career over marriage. She works late-night shifts and weekends, but one night, her life takes an unexpected turn when she impulsively becomes pregnant with the company's president and insists on marriage.

previousepisode.name: The Greatest Variable of My Life

name: Club Friday Theory of Love: A Mother's Mirror
summary: Love, though arising between two people, can only last if both families accept it, particularly the mother. There's a young woman so perfect, almost celestial, that no one dares reach for her. She has a close friend, a handsome young man who's always been by her side. He acts as her personal bodyguard, warding off ill-intentioned men. She can come and go from his home as if she were another of his mother's children. Everything takes a turn, however, when she transitions from friend to girlfriend. In his mother's eyes, she's stealing her son's love away.

name: Prijzenjacht
summary: In Prijzenjacht, two teams led by Rob Janssen compete for great prizes. It all revolves around one question: what is something worth? Who is price-conscious enough to win?

name: Niebo. Rok w piekle
summary: A psychological drama transformed into a thriller inspired by true events. Set in the early 1990s, the story follows a young, idealistic boy who abandons his studies and joins a religious sect.

name: Mr & Mrs with Julian Clary
summary: Mr & Mrs with Julian Clary is a revival of the classic couples quiz show, produced for ITV by Carlton Television. The series keeps the familiar format of testing how well partners know one another, but introduces a more mature, tongue-in-cheek tone. Fronted by Julian Clary, the show features playful innuendo and mischievous humour, offering a late-night, adult-leaning twist on the traditionally family-friendly original.

name: Kantan na Oshigoto desu. Ni obo shite Mita
Undercover Us
summary: Xie Cizhou, Lord of Yunzhou City, once rose to power with the support of Huanhua Valley, but his growing suspicion drove him into enmity with its master, Siyu, forcing the valley into seclusion from the martial world. Years later, Xie Cizhou's tyrannical rule sparks widespread resentment. In secret, his younger brother, Prince Xuanping Xie Ciyuan, counters him under the hidden identity of the head of Wufeng Pavilion. Fang Muwan, a successor of Huanhua Valley, was once trapped in a case of mistaken identity and married Xie Ciyuan for three years. She ultimately escaped by faking her own death through self-immolation, returned to the valley, and ascended as its new leader. Determined to sever all ties with the past, she becomes betrothed to Shi Jiu, a shadow guard. When an unresolved assassination attempt against the head of Wufeng Pavilion resurfaces, Fang Muwan takes matters into her own hands—only to discover that beneath the pavilion master's mask stands her former husband, Xie Ciyuan. As their eyes meet once more, national hatred, familial vengeance, and unextinguished love collide. This time, will the sword in her hand be turned toward the chaos of a troubled era, or toward the heart she has never truly understood?

name: Physical: Welcome to Mongolia
summary: After completing the grueling "Physical: Asia" finale, Team Mongolia leads their Korean teammates on a Mongolian trip of outdoor challenges and culture.

name: Clash of the Comics
summary: A wild and unpredictable event that sees some of the biggest names in comedy wrestling against each other and some of the UK's top professional wrestlers.

name: Spillet
summary: Spillet is an intense, social and psychological game about money, power and relationships.

name: И так далее с Михаилом Фишманом
summary: Every Friday, Mikhail Fishman presents his take on the past week. Together with key figures and analysts, Fishman attempts to understand the meaning and future direction of the key events and decisions of the previous seven days. And so it goes with Mikhail Fishman—debates and investigations, opinion pieces and dry analysis.

name: Run
summary: The extraordinary life of Australia's most notorious bank robber, Brenden Abbott, is dramatized in this high-octane series about his unprecedented career of crime and chaotic life on the run.

previousepisode.name: Some Things Last a Long Time

name: No, Your Majesty
summary:
"No, Your Majesty" follows James Taylor, a poor but brilliant scholarship student who enters an elite university hoping to escape poverty and build a future. Instead, he becomes the target of Prince William Davies, a spoiled, powerful heir raised under pressure and emotional neglect. Their first meeting is explosive, humiliating, and deeply charged. But as they clash, fight, and test each other's limits, their hostility slowly turns into a dangerous, magnetic attraction.

Around them, the elite students scheme and manipulate — especially Linda, William's self-declared fiancée — pushing the tension even further. Between scandals, bullying, secret moments, and unexpected vulnerability, James and William are forced to face not only each other, but the truth about themselves.

name: Wicked Game
summary:
Matt, a young grifter in the corrupt Vitarelli mafia clan, is deep in debt to his ruthless cousin Sebastian. His only way out? Spy on Marcus Gravano — a rival mafia boss known for his brutal methods and zero tolerance for betrayal. What starts as a desperate mission quickly spirals into a high-stakes seduction of power, survival, and identity.

The story begins with Matt crashing into Marcus's life in a chaotic, cross-dressing escape gone wrong — and from that moment, their connection is electric. Marcus, intrigued by Matt's audacity, makes him his personal servant instead of killing him. But Matt's double life gets more dangerous when he discovers Marcus isn't just a monster — he's a man who protects what's his, and maybe that includes Matt now.

name: Obsessed With You
summary:
Obsessed With You follows Tino, a talented nightclub dancer trapped in a toxic world controlled by a powerful club owner. His life is ruled by fear, debt, and the desperate need to save his sick sister.

Everything changes when Brendon, a police officer, crosses his path during a raid. What starts as a moment of silent help turns into a dangerous emotional bond. Love, guilt, obsession, and violence collide as Tino is forced to choose between survival and truth.

name: Waterwold of Komodo
summary: The Waterworld of Komodo takes the you on an extraordinary voyage to one of the most beautiful places on earth. Over the course of millions of years, the archipelago around the island of Komodo, has been shaped by the forces of nature and the mechanisms of evolution. Thanks to its isolation we are still able to stand face to face with works of nature which do not exist anywhere else on earth. On land, the legendary dragons reign undisputed, whilst under the water, strong currents surge through the coral reefs which are teeming with life. The underwater world is ruled by sharks and the majestic Manta Rays. Each episode shows you both of these worlds as well as the laws of nature which govern here. Dive into this unique ecosystem and discover a region where destructive volcanoes have periodically disrupted the order of the world. ‘The Waterworld of Komodo' is an amazing journey which leads to questions about the place of man on earth.
